icons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Mysteries Above, matching approved pixel-art Fool, Door, Sun, Justiciar, Death and Error sets. Full-canvas icon only, no sheet, atlas, grid, presentation margin or montage. High-quality disciplined PIXEL ART on a strict 32x32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID magnified with crisp nearest-neighbor square blocks. Broad connected clusters, stepped shadows, central silhouette about 24 logical pixels, readable at the real 24x24 wheel/book list size and 32x32 book detail size. Essential outlines at least 2 logical pixels, very few tiny speckles. No painterly detail, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, 3D or photorealism. Same simple SILVER SQUARE BEVEL FRAME at absolute canvas edges: ONE logical pixel wide (3.125 percent canvas per side), pale #AAAAB4 top/left, charcoal #4B4C58 bottom/right, one dark inset. No outside black margin or ornate corners. Nearly black navy interior #080F20, strong dark negative space. TYRANT primary exact #4673C7 (70,115,199), saturated royal/cobalt OCEAN BLUE. Keep BLUE visibly dominant, about two thirds of lit colored clusters, deep indigo shadows #16294D, limited pale blue #B5D6F2 highlights and tiny pearl white cores. It must not become cyan Door, dusty teal Error, green Death or gold Sun. Harmonious secondary colors communicate mechanism: turquoise water facets and ivory foam, lavender storm/spiritual shadows, small amber/orange lightning sparks, bronze skin, copper/brass navigation metal, jade healing, muted plum corrosion, warm embers being extinguished. Controlled local glow, no fuzzy bloom, rainbow noise or excessive white. Each ability has a distinct composition and concept, not one trident/lightning/wave recolored for all. No text, letters, numbers, written runes, music-note symbols, logos, religious crosses, UI diagrams or watermark.

Main body lit royal-blue #4673C7 with pale blue edge, smaller bronze skin planes, slate deep-water background and a little turquoise wake. Actual repeated physique gives vitality and swimming affinity, later underwater breathing, speed and deep-water senses. Athletic swimming strength, no armor, glowing gills, trident, static front torso or summoned sea monster. Wide streamlined silhouette unlike a charging surface lunge.
